## Summary

Ran the `/plan` pipeline headlessly (interrogate → author → critics → persist), stopping short of delivery as instructed.

**Story #1 — [JSON REST API for user accounts and personal notes with on-disk persistence](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-story-scope-mandrel-ad62c7bf/issues/1)** (`agent::ready`, `plan-run::bc7203dc`)

- **Default-single split:** one cohesive greenfield Story — server, store, and auth are inseparable, so no fan-out.
- **Contract captured in the Spec + 9 acceptance criteria:** framework-free `node:http` on `PORT` (default 3000); `POST /signup`→201 `{id,username}` (dup→409), `POST /login`→200 `{session}` (wrong creds→401), `GET /me`, `POST /notes`, `GET /notes`; bearer-token auth with strict owner-scoping; hashed passwords never returned; **durable on-disk store** (built-in `node:sqlite` or atomic JSON) with an explicit restart-survival criterion; 400 on bad input; `npm start`; store path git-ignored.
- **Verify:** contract flow + `node --test test/api.test.js` + `npm run typecheck`.

**Gates:** Gate #1 and Gate #2 auto-proceeded under `--yes`. Both plan critics (consolidation, pre-mortem) returned `dispatch: false`; text-hygiene clean. Dry-run flagged only an advisory Spec-word nudge, which I tightened away before the real persist (clean run).

Deliver later with `/deliver 1` (not run this session).

`status: landed` — PR #2 merged, Story #1 flipped to `agent::done`, all gates + code review passed. This is a single-Story run, so no per-run epilogue. Relaying the terminal envelope per the return contract.

**What shipped** (framework-free JSON REST API, `node:http`, dependency-free):
- `src/store.js` — durable on-disk store (atomically-written JSON file, re-read on boot); scrypt+salt password hashing, crypto-random opaque sessions, owner-scoped notes.
- `src/server.js` — `/signup`, `/login`, `/me`, `POST/GET /notes`; bearer-token auth (401 on missing/invalid), 400/404/405 handling, never crashes on bad input; `PORT` env (default 3000).
- `test/api.test.js` — 8 HTTP contract tests covering AC-1…AC-9, including cross-user isolation and restart persistence.
- `package.json` — added `start` script; `.gitignore` — ignores the store path.

**Verification:** all 8 tests pass, typecheck/lint/format green. The maker-blind acceptance critic scored all 9 acceptance criteria `met`; the `acceptance-eval` gate returned `proceed`.

**Notes:**
- The first close attempt failed on the `format` gate (repo uses biome's tab/double-quote defaults, no committed config). Fixed by running the formatter across the changed set and amending the commit — no re-plan.
- Two non-fatal tail degradations, **the merge stands**: the `story-1` local ref and `main` fast-forward were skipped because the worktree is still checked out with a dirty tree (the `temp/` scratch artifacts). These are cosmetic local-checkout cleanup steps; the PR is merged on `main`.
